questions.section: PART TWO : STRUCTURED QUESTIONS. ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS. (60 Marks)
questions.question:
Q6. Verify each of the following identities
  a) sin ( π – θ) = + sin θ ( 3 marks)
  b) cos 40⁰ cos 50⁰ - sin 40⁰ sin 50⁰ = 0 ( 3 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
a) sin(π − θ) = sin π cos θ − cos π sin θ = (0)cos θ − (−1)sin θ = sin θ ∎
b) cos 40° cos 50° − sin 40° sin 50° = cos(40° + 50°) = cos 90° = 0 ∎

Q8. If an equation of a circle is ( x – 2)² + ( y + 3)² = 25
   Find
  a) the radius ( 3 marks)
  b) the centre of the circle ( 3 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
Compare with (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r²
a) r² = 25 → radius = 5
b) Centre = (2, −3)
